title: Accounting & Reporting Expert
full_description:
At ING we are looking for Accounting & Reporting Expert
Your role and work environment:
We are looking for a talented and enthusiasticaccounting & reporting Expertto join ourBudget, accounting & reconciliationTeam of COO Office
The responsibility of this team is to reconcile all the accounts related to process we have in our COO Domain while the way of working is based on azure to manage our priorities and capacity the best way possible
Your key responsibilities:
As anAccounting & reporting expertyou will:
Balance of the daily settlement of transactions such as transfers (SEPA & SWIFTS), Checks, Bizum, Twyp & others ensuring the conformity of the amount
Analysis and resolution of localized differences in the daily settlement
Inventory of several products such as mortgages & loans with their respective quote’s conciliation
Detection and monitoring of the operations involved in the process
Support to process owners any relevant accounting difference
Report closing balances to finance justifying any relevant difference with their risk threshold.
Participate internal projects defining requirements to maintain the operative and testing results
While contributing to improvements in our actual processes to decrease the amount of manual load and become a team more dedicated to analysis
What are we looking for?
Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!
+4 years of experience on accounting/audit department, banking sector experience is a plus
Bachelor’s degree in accounting
Proactive contribution to improve our current processes
Proactive contribution to improve our current processes
Support and work with colleagues from your CoE and other COO
Monitor closely risk assessment along the process, assuring an excellent client experience.
Simplify solutions and processes and tell the story clearly to international stakeholders.
Apply your experience in the fast-changing context of transformation to achieve results.
Work closely with colleagues across ING to deliver results under challenging timelines.
You will be an ambassador of our culture displaying the Orange Code behaviors.
The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.
Check out what is waiting for you!
Be flexible my friend.
Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing.
So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.
Our house will be your home.
In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!
For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).
We help you protect what matters most to you.
Flexible remuneration.
In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…
Free company shuttle.
It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.
Special loans with more beneficial conditions.
Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.
And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!
More vitality and more belonging
360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).
Physiotherapy service on site.
Runners club with your own trainer.
Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.
Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+) & Leonas.
We are a team of more than 1600 people sharing one idea:doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.
Afully online bankwhere technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work withagile methodologies.
